recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if Patient Care resolves FHIR-32901 or another final issue that changes the broader guidance for representing patient-level family-history assertions or constrains use of the FAMMEMB relationship code.
issue_request: FHIR-6958 was a Published Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking how to represent maternal or paternal family history when the specific family member is unknown and the HL7 v3 FAMMEMB value set does not contain an exact relationship code. The accepted resolution was to add usage notes explaining that a full family history can be represented as a List containing both FamilyMemberHistory records and Observation records such as "maternal family history of breast cancer".
initial_application: Historical commit 0e27d81352ab196b08ee9da5c175117cd2381324, with subject "#8074, #6958", added the FamilyMemberHistory notes paragraph with the requested List, FamilyMemberHistory, Observation, and maternal-family-history example. Later source edits corrected and expanded the paragraph without removing the FHIR-6958 guidance.
additional_context: FamilyMemberHistory is active current-build source in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-8074 was implemented in the same historical commit and already has a combined-branch audit commit. FHIR-32901 later discusses broader List-vs-FamilyMemberHistory guidance and FAMMEMB misuse concerns, but it is Triaged/Unresolved and not a final source-edit decision. FHIR-9028 later left FamilyMemberHistory.relationship bound to the v3 family-member value set at example strength.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current build-scope source already carries the substantive usage-note guidance requested by FHIR-6958, and no later final decision found in the bounded investigation requires changing it.
